notes: Jennov is a budget Amazon PoE/WiFi camera brand whose ecosystem centers on its CamHipro / VideoLink / HiP2P mobile+desktop apps. Official Jennov resources (jennov.com support page, FAQ-CamHipro, FAQ-VideoLink, and the blog posts 'How to Find the RTSP URL for an IP Camera' and 'How does RTSP Work?') give ONLY generic RTSP guidance — 'connect with rtsp://login:password@IP:554/path' and 'find the path in the camera web UI / via ONVIF discovery' — and never publish a fixed, model-specific stream path. Cameras are ONVIF-capable and stream over RTSP on port 554, so ONVIF auto-discovery is the reliable route to the actual per-device URL. The concrete '/stream2' default that circulates comes exclusively from third-party crowd-sourced VMS sites (iSpyConnect, camlytics), which the spec explicitly treats as leads, not manufacturer documentation. No official Jennov doc confirms any candidate path, so status is unverified (honest result, mirroring the D-Link /play*.sdp case).
